requirement_text.REQ-383: Company appearance settings screen: apply/adjust branding colours, surface contrast refusal, surface rejected-out-of-scope-change confirmation. Second of two requirements from the same GUI-review finding as REQ-382 -- see REQ-382's description for the full 'what exists today' trace and test/uat-reports/gui-review-2026-09-20-tenant-branding-applied.md. Blocked on REQ-382 landing (there is no real endpoint to wire to yet, now merged). Grepping web/src/pages/admin/ confirms there is no appearance/branding settings screen today -- EditTenantPage.tsx (the only per-tenant admin edit screen) has no colour/branding field at all, only display_name. THIS REQUIREMENT: a tenant-admin-reachable screen (e.g. under web/src/pages/admin/tenants/ alongside EditTenantPage.tsx, or a dedicated web/src/pages/admin/AppearanceSettingsPage.tsx -- CODE-DESIGNER's call) that (1) lets the tenant admin submit a new brand_colors.primary value and calls REQ-382's endpoint (EO-001's positive half); (2) on a successful save, shows a plain confirmation and the applied colour takes effect immediately without a full page reload being required to see it reflected somewhere on the same screen; (3) on a request that also attempts an out-of-scope change (any field this screen does not itself expose -- since this screen's own form cannot construct an out-of-scope key by construction, this criterion is satisfied by confirming the screen has no way to submit one, not by testing a server-side reject path a same-origin form can never trigger); (4) on a contrast-refused submission (REQ-382's new validation), shows the endpoint's plain-language refusal message and leaves the previous colour visibly in effect, never a raw validation-error blob (EO-003); (5) confirms platform status colours (approved/waiting/failed, e.g. on web/src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx-rendered screens) are unaffected by any tenant colour change, which already holds structurally today (BRAND_COLOR_CSS_PROPERTY's allowlist has exactly one key, 'primary', mapped only to --color-brand-600 -- --color-success/--color-warning/--color-error/--color-failure are separate custom properties web/src/theming/applyBranding.ts never touches; this criterion needs a regression test, not new code) -- EO-002. Once this screen is confirmed correct against a real running instance, remove this scenario's stale NOTE (ISS-0527) from test/fixtures/uat/scenarios/platform/tenant-branding-applied.yaml and author web/tests/e2e/pipelines/tenant-branding.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts (the path the scenario's own pipeline_test already names) against the real screen, including a first-paint screenshot for EO-005. EO-005 NOTE (documented, not this requirement's job to fix): web/src/theming/BrandingProvider.tsx applies branding in a useEffect, which runs strictly after first paint, and main.tsx renders the app tree synchronously without awaiting the pre-warmed fetchTenantConfig promise -- so the very first drawn frame always shows tokens.css's platform-default --color-brand-600, then swaps to the tenant's colour once the network round-trip resolves. This is a real, confirmed flash, but the scenario's own EO-005 carries severity: MINOR and suggested_action: none -- so this requirement's own EO-005 acceptance criterion only asks the new pipeline_test to DOCUMENT the flash (screenshot the first frame vs. the settled frame), not eliminate it. Fixing it is out of scope here.
